digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec and sync
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments fail to encode Markdown as structured ADF, instead emitting plain-text paragraphs that appear as literal source in Jira
Jira-authored rich text (panels, mentions, dates) is lost or mangled when pulled back into rebar because codecs lack round-trip safety and origin-gating
Data Center wiki markup rendering via pandoc must be one-way (Markdown→wiki) with safety fallback, timeout-bounded, and GPL/SBOM hardened, while preserving dangerous prose and ASCII tables verbatim
Echo-safety requires ADR-0026 per-binding baseline tracking, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way LWW conflict detection to suppress spurious re-emits and flag concurrent edits
Append-only comment sync must route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions and persist Jira-comment-ID mappings, never syncing deletes or edits

Live cutover and cross-repo contract verification (rendered HTML via expand=renderedFields, second-pass convergence, conflict safety) require dockerized Jira DC harness and operator-dispatched integration testing
